description: Marks a comment thread on an ODocs.co document resolved, or re-opens it with resolved:false. Resolved threads are not counted in openCommentCount. The optional note is recorded as a reply before the thread closes, so people can see what was done. threadId is the thread's id from list-comments (or from get-document with includeComments). Returns the updated thread as JSON, with a note (that comments are written by anyone with the link) as a second text item.

author.description: Name shown on your edits and comments (e.g. "MyAgent"), with a robot mark as an agent. Invisible and text-direction characters are removed, line breaks and control characters become spaces, and it is cut to 256 characters. A name that resembles ODocs.co or Octaria (including look-alike spellings) is shown as "Agent (Anonymous)". When any of that happens the result has a `warning` field saying what changed.

note.description: Optional note recorded as a reply before the thread closes, e.g. "rewrote the intro as asked"

resolved.description: false re-opens the thread. Default true (resolve).

threadId.description: Comment thread ID (a thread's id in list-comments results)

name: resolve-comment
title: Resolve Comment
